details.raw_sql:
-- analysing appointment step drop for DE primarily  
-- would analyse based on what the user is doing pre drop off
	-- one such hypothesis is that they are brownfield user and are seeing already existing CONNECTION
	-- what other possible reasons can be for the user not being able to proceed - Are they receiving any error business or technical 
	-- for those who interacted with the date picker or slot picker, what was the first available date and available slots -- don't have this DATA
	-- for those who picked completed the appointment what datediff diff they pick and what was their preferred slot
	
-- how long was the session active after last activity on the appointment page i.e. based on last event on the appointment page and the last event on the session id 
	-- in appointment sub step viewed there is something called manual research. Need to check appointment success % of those users vs others 
-- how does the drop off look like broken down by the quality of cart 

	
with arraybase AS (
    SELECT uuid 
	, identifiers_user_id
	-- , ARRAY_JOIN(ARRAY_SORT(ARRAY_AGG(DISTINCT tariff_name)), ' | ') 
	, ARRAY_JOIN( ARRAY_DISTINCT(ARRAY_AGG( CONCAT(product_service_line, ' ', name) ORDER BY LENGTH(id), id ) ), ' | ' ) AS items_chosen
    , max( case when UPPER(TRIM(arr.business_group)) = 'TARIFF'
      AND (
            LOWER(TRIM(arr.contract_card_type)) = 'maincard'
            OR arr.contract_card_type IS NULL
          )
      AND arr.product_id IS NOT NULL  then Name end ) main_item_name
    FROM eshop_data.es_events_arr_v2 arr
    -- WHERE date BETWEEN  {{start_date}} AND {{end_date}}
	where date between date_add('day', -14 , CURRENT_DATE) and date_add('day', -1 , CURRENT_DATE) 
	AND LOWER(nc) = 'de'
   group by 1,2
)
,base as (
	SELECT 
    ev.identifiers_sessionid
    ,ev.action
    ,ev.label
    ,ev.identifiers_page_name
    ,ev.identifiers_log_time
	, ev.attr_elementtitle 
	, from_unixtime(ev.identifiers_log_time / 1000.0) event_timestamp
    ,ev.service_line
    ,ev.internalemployee
    ,ev.service_line
    ,ev.identifiers_user_id
    ,ev.identifiers_customer_type
    ,COALESCE(ev.attr_items, ev.attr_list, ev.attributelist)                    AS item_array_uuid
    ,ev.de_ingestion_id                                                         AS event_id
	,case when ev.identifiers_page_name = 'checkout/appointment' and lower(ev.service_line)  like '%fixed%' and action = 'radioButtonClicks' then ev.attr_option_selected  end as time_slot
    -- CAST(REPLACE(CAST(ev.identifiers_log_time AS VARCHAR), ',', '') AS BIGINT) AS log_time,
	,items_chosen
	,main_item_name
    -- SELECT ev.service_line, ev.identifiers_page_category_2, count(*) cnt
	FROM eshop_data.es_events_v2 AS ev
	left join arraybase arr on 
		COALESCE(ev.attr_items, ev.attr_list, ev.attributelist) = arr.uuid
		-- AND DATE(ev.date) = DATE(arr.date)
WHERE 
    ev.nc = 'de'
    AND ev.internalemployee = 'no'
    AND ev.identifiers_page_name LIKE 'checkout%'
    AND ev.category LIKE 'acquisition'
    AND ev.date between date_add('day', -14 , CURRENT_DATE) and date_add('day', -1 , CURRENT_DATE) 
    -- AND lower(ev.category) <> 'addonmanagement'
    -- AND (
    --     'All' IN ({{service_line}})
    --     OR lower(ev.service_line) = lower({{service_line}})
    --     OR lower(ev.identifiers_page_category_2) = lower({{service_line}})
    -- )
	AND (
 			lower(ev.service_line) = lower('fixed')
        OR lower(ev.identifiers_page_category_2) = lower('fixed')
    )
	-- and ev.identifiers_sessionid= '8de9dd013b5ea8de905483ce3924bc44944404cf5c91fac5bd1a045cc4ee9aead65b9c04fc220f7c117d129d3dba66e61e8df4c896f49675abc3c5f3ea9bac75'
)

,intd as
(
SELECT 
	identifiers_sessionid
	-- max( case when  )
	, min(case when action = 'PageView' AND identifiers_page_name = 'checkout/appointment' then identifiers_log_time end ) first_appointment_page_view 
	, max(case when identifiers_page_name = 'checkout/appointment' then identifiers_log_time end ) latest_appointment_page_activity_time 
	, max(case when  action = 'checkoutStepSubmitted' AND identifiers_page_name = 'checkout/appointment' then identifiers_log_time end ) latest_appointment_completion_time
	, MAX(case when action = 'PageView' AND identifiers_page_name = 'checkout/appointment' then 1 else 0 end) AS appointment_page
	, max(case when identifiers_page_name = 'checkout/appointment' and action = 'checkoutSubStepViewed' and lower(label) like '%manual%research' then 1 else 0 end  ) flag_manual_search_flow_user
	, max(case when identifiers_page_name = 'checkout/appointment' and identifiers_user_id is not null and lower(identifiers_customer_type) like '%brown%' then '1. brownfield' 
				when identifiers_page_name = 'checkout/appointment' and identifiers_user_id is not null and lower(identifiers_customer_type) like '%green%' then '0. greenfield'
				when  identifiers_page_name = 'checkout/appointment'  and identifiers_user_id is not null then '-1.user_id available'
				else '-2. user not logged in' end  ) customer_type
	, MAX(case when action = 'clickInteractions' and label = 'date picked' AND identifiers_page_name = 'checkout/appointment' then 1 else 0 end) AS date_picker_click
	, MAX(case when action = 'datePickerViewed' and label = 'bookingAppointmentDate' AND identifiers_page_name = 'checkout/appointment' then 1 else 0 end) AS date_picker_view
	, MAX(case when action = 'dateSelected' and label = 'bookingAppointmentDate' AND identifiers_page_name = 'checkout/appointment' then 1 else 0 end) AS date_selected
	, MAX(case when action = 'radioButtonClicks' AND identifiers_page_name = 'checkout/appointment' then 1 else 0 end) AS time_slot
	, max(case when  
			(
				(action = 'clickInteractions' and label = 'date picked' )
				or 
				(action = 'clickInteractions' and label = 'date picked')
				or 
				(action = 'datePickerViewed' and label = 'bookingAppointmentDate')
				or
				(action = 'dateSelected' and label = 'bookingAppointmentDate' )
				or
				(action = 'radioButtonClicks')
			) AND identifiers_page_name = 'checkout/appointment'
		then 1 else 0 end 
			) any_interaction_done
	, max(case when action = 'popupAppears' and label = 'warning - customer already have an existing contract' then 1 else 0 end ) already_existing_contract_user
	, max(case when action = 'clickInteractions' and  attr_elementtitle = 'warning - customer already have an existing contract' then label end ) existing_contract_response
	, MAX(case when action = 'checkoutStepSubmitted' AND identifiers_page_name = 'checkout/appointment' then 1 else 0 end) AS appointment_submitted
	, max(case when action = 'purchaseSuccess' AND identifiers_page_name = 'checkout/consent' then 1 else 0 end ) acq_purchase_success
FROM 

	base 
GROUP BY 1
)
, intd_with_additional_fields as (
	Select * 
	, case when latest_appointment_completion_time is not null then latest_appointment_completion_time else latest_appointment_page_activity_time end appointment_page_exit_time
	from intd
)

, latest_prior_to_appointment_completion_calc as (  -- to get the state prior to appointment exit
	Select b.identifiers_sessionid 
	, min(from_unixtime(itd.appointment_page_exit_time/1000))  appointment_page_exit_timestamp
	, max(concat( lpad(CAST( b.identifiers_log_time AS VARCHAR), 20, '0') , 'axyb' , b.items_chosen ) ) latest_chosen_items_calc
	, max(concat( lpad(CAST( b.identifiers_log_time AS VARCHAR), 20, '0') , 'axyb' , b.main_item_name ) ) latest_chosen_main_item_calc
	, max(concat( lpad(CAST( b.identifiers_log_time AS VARCHAR), 20, '0') , 'axyb' , b.time_slot ) ) latest_chosen_time_slot_calc
	from base b
	left join intd_with_additional_fields itd 
		on b.identifiers_sessionid = itd.identifiers_sessionid 
		and b.identifiers_log_time <= itd.appointment_page_exit_time
	group by 1
)
, latest_prior_to_appointment_completion as 
(
	Select lpc.identifiers_sessionid
		, split_part(lpc.latest_chosen_items_calc , 'axyb', 2) latest_chosen_items
		, split_part(lpc.latest_chosen_main_item_calc , 'axyb', 2) latest_chosen_main_item
		, split_part(lpc.latest_chosen_time_slot_calc , 'axyb', 2) latest_chosen_time_slot
		, appointment_page_exit_timestamp
	from latest_prior_to_appointment_completion_calc lpc
)
,tc_agg_fields as (
	SELECT 
    ev.identifiers_sessionid
	, MAX(case when ev.identifiers_page_name like '%checkout%' then 1 else 0 end) AS tc_landed_on_checkout
	
	, MAX(case when ev.action = 'clickInteractions' AND ev.identifiers_page_name = 'checkout/consent' and ev.label='place order' then 1 else 0 end) AS tc_order_placed
	, MAX(case when ev.action = 'purchaseSuccess' AND ev.identifiers_page_name = 'checkout/consent' then 1 else 0 end) AS tc_order_success
	
	FROM eshop_data.es_events_v2 AS ev
	-- inner join intd_with_additional_fields ind on ev.identifiers_sessionid = ind.identifiers_sessionid and lower(ind.customer_type) like '%brown%'
	WHERE 
    ev.nc = 'de'
    AND ev.internalemployee = 'no'
    AND (ev.identifiers_page_name LIKE '%checkout%' )
    AND lower(ev.category) LIKE '%tariffchange%'
    AND ev.date between date_add('day', -14 , CURRENT_DATE) and date_add('day', -1 , CURRENT_DATE) 
	AND (
 			lower(ev.service_line) = lower('fixed')
        OR lower(ev.identifiers_page_category_2) = lower('fixed')
    )
	group by 1
	-- and ev.identifiers_sessionid= '8de9dd013b5ea8de905483ce3924bc44944404cf5c91fac5bd1a045cc4ee9aead65b9c04fc220f7c117d129d3dba66e61e8df4c896f49675abc3c5f3ea9bac75'
)
-- Select * from tc_agg_fields;
Select i.identifiers_sessionid
	, i.first_appointment_page_view
	, i.latest_appointment_page_activity_time
	, i.latest_appointment_completion_time
	, i.appointment_page
	, i.flag_manual_search_flow_user
	, i.customer_type
	, i.date_picker_click
	, i.date_picker_view
	, i.date_selected
	, i.time_slot
	, i.any_interaction_done
	, i.already_existing_contract_user
	, i.appointment_submitted
	, i.acq_purchase_success
	, lpc.latest_chosen_items , lpc.latest_chosen_main_item , lpc.latest_chosen_time_slot
	,appointment_page_exit_timestamp
	, hour(appointment_page_exit_timestamp) hour_appointment_page_time  -- to help answer if it is early bird catches the worm syndrome
	, date_diff('second', from_unixtime(first_appointment_page_view/1000) , from_unixtime(appointment_page_exit_time/1000) ) time_on_appointment_page
	, tc.tc_landed_on_checkout
	, tc.tc_order_placed
	, tc.tc_order_success
	, i.existing_contract_response
	, ' ' gap_col
from intd_with_additional_fields i 
left join latest_prior_to_appointment_completion lpc on i.identifiers_sessionid = lpc.identifiers_sessionid
left join tc_agg_fields tc on tc.identifiers_sessionid = i.identifiers_sessionid
where appointment_page= 1

metadata.general_context: This query is used to RCA the drop in checkout at the appointment stag for the fixed acquisition funnel. I am checking conversion at various cut increase customer type, customer interaction depth, and basis the items they added to cart.
